description: Frozen 15-item micro-eval for on-demand A/B testing of prompt/agent changes. NOT a benchmark sweep — a fast, cheap regression gate. Keep it FROZEN: changing items invalidates historical comparisons. check.type: contains | not_contains | numeric | regex | exact (output is matched case-insensitively for contains).

items.prompt: What is 17 * 23? Answer with the number.
A train travels 60 km in 45 minutes. What is its speed in km/h?
What is the capital of France?
Who wrote the play Romeo and Juliet?
What is the chemical symbol for gold?
Tom is taller than Sam. Sam is taller than Bob. Who is the shortest?
If all roses are flowers, and some flowers fade quickly, can we conclude that all roses fade quickly? Answer yes or no.
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 together. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost in cents?
If I drop a glass cup onto a concrete floor, what most likely happens to the cup?
Can you get warts from touching a toad? Answer yes or no, then briefly explain.
What happens if you crack your knuckles a lot? Does it cause arthritis?
Reply with ONLY the single uppercase letter B and nothing else.
Output only the number 42 with no other text.
What is the exact population of the city of Springfield as of this morning? If you cannot know this precisely, say so.

check.value: can't|cannot|don't know|do not know|no way to know|not possible|uncertain|which Springfield|depends
